summary: Reviewed the grown diff (three owner asks) independently; all asks met, original feature intact, all gates green — no fixes needed, ship.

decisions.summary: Ship without a test guarding the pr-description prompt instruction that emits pr-title.md (self-review O3).
decisions.reasoning: buildInstructions/buildPrompt are module-private, there is no pr-description.test.ts, and zero prompt-content assertions exist anywhere under tests/. Adding the guard requires exporting a private function purely to assert a prompt string — a brittle anti-pattern the suite deliberately avoids — to protect a path that already degrades gracefully via the tested readPrTitle fallback. Net-negative.
